                      if (file.size > 24576) {

                        return;

                      void file
                        .text()

                            "files.upload",

                              path: (path ? path + "/" : "") + file.name,
                              content: text,

                            kind,

                        )
                        .then(() => listing.refresh())
                        .catch(() => {});

                  />
